plugin.name: Summaryception
plugin.description:
Layered recursive summarization memory. Compresses old chat turns into ultra-compact summary snippets organized in recursive layers.

Old Layer 0 snippets (direct message summary) are saved and can be sent with the Summary as Retrigged Memories, making the AI never forgets important events, even after thousand turns.

Original version by Lodactio
Heavy jailbreak by dptgreg
settings.info: Summaryception compresses old chat turns into layered recursive summaries. Summarized messages are hidden from the LLM but stay visible in your chat. ~11,000 turns fit in ~16k tokens.
